title: Saintly
summary: SA'INTLY, adjective Like a saint; becoming a holy person; as wrongs with saintly patience borne. SAINT PETER'S WORT, noun A plant of the genus Ascyrum, and another of the genus Hypericum. SA'INT'S BEL

inlines.v: SA'INTLY, adjective Like a saint; becoming a holy person; as wrongs with saintly patience borne. SAINT PETER'S WORT, noun A plant of the genus Ascyrum, and another of the genus Hypericum. SA'INT'S BELL, noun A small bell rung in churches when the priest repeats the words sancte, sancte, sancte, Deus sabaoth, that persons absent might fall on their knees in reverence of the holy office.
